Development
On 17 September 2019, it was announced that
Armas de mujer
was in development for NBC's planned streaming service,
Peacock
.
[
3
]
Filming of the series began on 6 February 2021 and wrapped in April of that same year.

4

Kate del Castillo
was cast in a leading role for the series.

Matias Novoa

4

Roselyn Sánchez

Jeimy Osorio
